g.text: Bench frame members, pan plates and sleeve connections
C2 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY DESIGN — NOT FOR CONSTRUCTION
HOLLOW-STEEL CUT LIST · QUANTITY PER BENCH
HSS candidate ASTM A500 Grade C; all lengths are square-cut nominal.
BF08 sleeve bores Ø0.500, axis X; four through-tube sleeves BP04.
BP04: OD0.500 / ID0.28125 × 1.500 nominal; match measured tube width.
BP03: four A36 pan tabs 1.500 × 1.500 × 0.1875; centred Ø0.28125.
BP05: two A36 rear post caps 2.000 × 2.000 × 0.0625.
Pan fixings and pad retainers still to select.
Every quantity is per bench; multiply by 16 for one regular coach. HP01–04 / HW01–03 quantities are on C2-J01 and C2-P01.
Use exact instance coordinates in parts.json for assembly. Proposed welds need qualified fit-up / WPS and the stated engineering checks.
Back pan holes align through BP04 sleeves in BF08; do not use the superseded floating-tab concept.
Pans, frame and hardpoints are physical solids. Upholstery, fixing hardware, trim and pinch / sharp-edge protection remain unfinished.
C2-P02 · Canonical: build_c2.py / parameters.json / parts.json / drawing-edges.json · Dimensions govern; do not scale.
